_help: Copy this file to worker/secrets/sites.json and fill it in. That folder is git-ignored.
One block per job site. Use a DIFFERENT password for each site, never your Google password.
match: a word from the site's web address (example: randstad) so the worker picks the right login.
login_url: the page where you type your email and password (optional, can stay empty).
Remove the _help lines in your real file if you like; the worker ignores keys that start with _.
